title: RideLink Transit Pass — Monthly Pass Issuance Rule
content:
On the RideLink Transit Pass level of Non-Emergency Medical Transportation, trips are made on fixed-route transit, and the member receives either a monthly pass or single-ride tickets.

**Rule.** On RideLink Transit Pass, one pass of the level's pass type is issued for a calendar month in which the member has at least the level's required number of covered appointments; otherwise single-ride tickets are mailed per appointment. A pass is never issued for a month already issued.

**Counting the month's covered appointments.** The count for a calendar month adds:

- the distinct appointment dates, in that month, on the member's booked RideLink trips whose trip purpose is not a value-added purpose; and
- the covered appointments the member shows on the claims of their Medicaid Managed Care Membership with a service date in that month.

Two booked trips on the same appointment date count as one appointment date.

## Worked month counts

*Hypothetical months, with the RideLink Transit Pass requirement of 3 covered appointments:*

| Booked medical appointment dates in the month | Covered appointments shown on plan claims in the month | Count | Result for the month |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 distinct dates | 0 | 3 | One monthly pass |
| 2 distinct dates | 1 | 3 | One monthly pass |
| 2 trips on the same date, 1 on another date | 0 | 2 | Single-ride tickets mailed per appointment |
| 1 date, plus 2 value-added trips to a food bank | 0 | 1 | Single-ride tickets mailed per appointment |

## Points of judgement

- A month that already has a pass issued never receives a second one.
- Value-added trips never add to the month's count.
